messages.subject: melt and POSIXct
parts:
Hi,

I'm hoping that this is something of a softball for you all, I'm just
not coming up with ideas

t.start <- as.POSIXct(strptime('1/4/2005/00',"%d/%m/%Y/%H"),tz='MST')
dum.frame <- data.frame(time=as.POSIXct(t.start.05 + (3600*(0:
(1*24))) ,tz='MST'),
var1=1:25, var2=runif(25),
label=factor(c(rep('a',13),rep('b',12))) )
m.dum <- melt(dum.frame)

i get the error:
Using label as id variables
Error in as.POSIXct.numeric(value) : 'origin' must be supplied

I'm kind of a newb with POSIX, so I'm hoping this is obvious. (Or
maybe I shouldnt want to do this at all?)

Best regards and thanks,

James
